text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"a fifth of the jellyfish"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"a third of the large jellyfish"},{"id":"q3","value":6,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"6 jellyfish changed color"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply the two fraction denominators (fifth and third) to find what fraction of the whole tank the color-changing jellyfish represent (1/15)"},{"op":"mul","args":["q3","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"since 6 jellyfish are that 1/15 of the total, multiply by 15 to scale up to the whole tank"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of jellyfish in the tank"},"dismissed":[]}
